observations: White DAF CF series truck with a crane mounted behind the cab.
Cab door in photo 0 shows 'DAF 75.310' and 'CHADWICKS' livery with an Irish address.
Front view in photo 1 shows 'DAF' and 'CF' badges.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the hydraulic control valve block for the crane.
The truck has three axles; a 10-tyre configuration is standard for this 3-axle setup with dual rear wheels.
The vehicle appears to be a used import still carrying foreign company branding.

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the interior gear selector or dashboard.
A crane is present, but the brand name is not legible in the photos.
Requires mechanical testing and operation videos.

risks.risk: The crane (HIAB) may have hydraulic leaks or structural/mechanical failure.
risks.proof: Video of the crane performing a full lift and rotation cycle.

risks.risk: Engine or automatic transmission may have significant wear or faults.
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting from cold and the truck driving through gears.

risks.risk: High mileage or high engine hours not disclosed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the odometer and hour meter on the dashboard.

proof_requests: Video of the crane in full operation (extending, lifting, and rotating).
Video of the engine running and the truck being driven.
Photo of the odometer and instrument cluster with the engine running.
Photos of the tyre treads to verify condition.
Photo of the vehicle identification plate and registration documents.
response.reason: The truck is clearly identified as a DAF CF 75.310. While mechanical condition and crane functionality are unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value for these components.
